health.neverUpdated: The Brain Update has never run successfully.
health.fixNeverUpdated: Run `confidant update` once by hand to see what happens, or check that the Commitment Tracker + Brain Update scheduled task is still active.
health.staleUpdate: The last successful update was {hours} hours ago.
health.fixStaleUpdate: Run `confidant update` by hand, or check that the Commitment Tracker + Brain Update scheduled task is still active and has not been paused.
health.fixFullDiskAccess: Grant Full Disk Access to the ChatGPT app in System Settings > Privacy & Security, then run `confidant extract` again.
health.fixKey: The {source} key looks invalid or missing. Run `confidant keys set {source}` with a fresh key.
health.fixSourceGeneric: Run `confidant extract --source {source} --probe` to see the exact error.
health.backlogStuck: The sorting backlog has not moved in {days} days.
health.fixBacklogStuck: Run `confidant update` by hand and read what it prints; the backlog only grows if merging keeps failing.
health.lowDisk: This Mac is low on disk space.
health.fixLowDisk: Free up space on this Mac. Confidant needs room for the vault database to keep growing.
health.notWritable: The vault folder cannot be written to right now.
health.fixNotWritable: Check that the vault folder still exists at its original path and has not had its permissions changed.
health.taskInactive: The {task} scheduled task is not active.
health.fixTaskInactive: Recreate the {task} task, or check Automations in the ChatGPT app to see whether it was paused or removed.
